title: Impl: Python cover traffic generator
description: Add cover traffic to Python node: one dummy OSCORE packet per superframe to preferred gateway, padded to standard size class. Use BULK priority (P4) so real traffic always preempts. File: python/src/lichen/crypto/cover_traffic.py or integrate into node.py scheduler. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest tests/test_cover_traffic.py -x
